mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment reduces the cost of capital for corporate investment and consumer borrowing, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in payrolls signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a high economic growth regime as indicated by GDPC1 growth above 2.5% annually, strong housing starts (HOUST) signal robust consumer demand and construction activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annually and HOUST > 1250.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production, as measured by INDPRO, indicates robust manufacturing activity and corporate output, which supports earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO is above 100.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1250 thousand units, it signals strong consumer demand for residential construction and associated economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1250.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5% for three consecutive months, it signals an overheating labor market that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 320.0 indicates an aggressive monetary tightening cycle coupled with high inflation, which compresses profit margins and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 320.0.
